text: What seat count did Gideon land on for Vantorre Group in the July thread in #strategic-pod? He corrected himself in that thread and I want the corrected figure for the QBR deck.
reply_text: Gideon's corrected figure for Vantorre Group is 280 seats. He first posted 300 at 09:14 on July 1 in #strategic-pod, then corrected it at 09:19, saying the 300 included sandbox logins from the May rollout. He gave 280 as the active seats on the production roster as of July 1.
